# Yicai Global

> > English-language business news platform covering China's economy, policy developments, industry trends, and corporate news from Shanghai-based Yicai.

Yicai Global provides comprehensive coverage of Chinese business, finance, and economic policy, with focus on GDP growth targets, five-year plans, manufacturing sectors, and major Chinese corporations. The platform serves international audiences seeking insights into China's development strategies and market dynamics.

## Key Topics

- China economic policy
- Five-Year Plan targets
- GDP growth and development
- Carbon emissions and sustainability
- Digital economy initiatives
- Manufacturing and automotive sectors
- Shanghai business hub
- Chinese corporate news
- Real estate market
- COVID-19 economic impact
- R&D investment
- Hydrogen fuel cells
- Port infrastructure
- Sensor technology clusters

## Economic Policy & National Development

- [China Unveils Major Development Targets for 2026-2030](https://www.yicaiglobal.com/news/china-unveils-major-development-targets-for-2026-2030): China's 15th Five-Year Plan targets for GDP, R&D, and carbon emissions
- [China Sets 2026 Economic Growth Target at 4.5-5 Percent](https://www.yicaiglobal.com/news/china-sets-2026-economic-growth-target-at-45-5-percent): China announces 2026 GDP growth target and employment goals

## Industry & Manufacturing

- [China's Hubei Province Unveils Plan for USD4.4 Billion Sensor Industry Hub by 2030](https://www.yicaiglobal.com/news/chinas-hubei-province-unveils-plan-to-develop-usd44-billion-sensor-industry-hub-by-2030): Hubei's Wuhan Optics Valley sensor industry cluster development plan
- [Guangzhou Sets Out Plan for USD1.4 Billion Fuel Cell Vehicle Industry by 2025](https://www.yicaiglobal.com/news/guangzhou-sets-out-plan-for-usd14-billion-fuel-cell-vehicle-industry-by-2025?h2feed=): Guangzhou's hydrogen fuel cell vehicle and infrastructure development plan
- [ZPMC's Shares Drop After US Flags Potential Security Issue With China-Made Port Cranes](https://www.yicaiglobal.com/news/chinese-crane-giant-zpmc-drop-as-us-calls-out-china-made-cranes-over-port-cybersecurity-issues?trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block): ZPMC stock falls after Biden administration raises port crane security concerns
